summary: The world felt alive as it reacted to my actions and presented me with various challenges and opportunities. I encountered several NPCs, including Brother Aldric and Sister Maren, who had their own agendas and motivations. The game also introduced a counter-brotherhood and a mysterious gathering at an old crypt, which added to the sense of intrigue and danger. However, some commands were not recognized, and I experienced a few moments of confusion.
